name: Nymph
text: Nymphs are a family of fey whose affinity with nature goes beyond nearly any other creature. They form a symbiotic bond with a single natural feature such as a tree or pond, guarding it from danger. In exchange, they're sustained and strengthened by nature, granting them near-immortality. As many types of nymphs exist as there are natural environments, with dryads and naiads being the most common. There are rumors of nymphs from far more hostile and remote locales, but most of these claims remain unconfirmed. Nymphs live either in complete solitude, protecting their charge so intently that they isolate themselves from others, or in tightly interconnected communities with other fey.
